p5_b0.ocr: The analysis presented in the accompanying table highlights the median improvement in Catquest-9SF scores across various cohorts affected by the H1N1 virus, specifically differentiating between individuals with and without comorbidities.

This disparity suggests a significant influence of comorbidities on the perceived quality of care indicators and overall health outcomes following viral challenges.
